scope: Controlled current-identity full shop chain, native browser mouse/touch/DOM. Public fixtures, no natural acquisition or physical device/human acceptance.

checks: real candidate and five slots show original art, explicit real stars, price and losses; compare return restores fifth slot
held close and Escape both restore comparison fifth-slot scroll/focus without commands
purchase quota failure preserves complete state/journal/storage; retry saves one original BuyOffer
sale cancel returns to same held card; explicit sell then buy remain separate original saved transactions
store returns to stock; owned target cancel preserves paid item; explicit use returns to inventory/stock with same context
basic quick-use purchase enters original target selector; cancel keeps inventory and stock scroll
quota failure publishes no new state; retry saves exactly the original use and restores continuation
complete cold restored state/journal/IDB equals final saved chain
